# Expected values: BigQuery's ROUND examples and overflow error:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/mathematical_functions.md
# SAFE. returns NULL for an evaluation error.

SELECT ROUND(x, -1) FROM UNNEST([123.7]) x
=> "120.0"

SELECT ROUND(x, 2) FROM UNNEST([1.235]) x
=> "1.24"

SELECT ROUND(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1.235 AS x, 2 AS digits)])
=> "1.24"

SELECT ROUND(x, -308) FROM UNNEST([1.6e308]) x
=> error:

SELECT SAFE.ROUND(x, -308) FROM UNNEST([1.6e308]) x
=> null
